programme.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
programme.desc: Officers get a surprise with narcotics hide within a shipment of rubber; suspicions raise when a routine X-ray reveals packages hidden inside the tires of a truck; a missing teenager with a rap sheet is turned in to the authorities.

programme.title: Contraband: Seized at the Border

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm
programme.desc: When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm
programme.desc: Eyewitnesses capture severe weather across the Dakotas as tornadoes tear through neighborhoods and farm structures; near Enderlin, North Dakota, a violent twister with estimated winds exceeding 200 mph becomes the first U.S. tornado rated EF5 in more than 12 years.

programme.title: In the Eye of the Storm

programme.desc: Darrin leads a water pipeline build. Patrick calls out his partners; Adam squares off with a deadly viper; Dani scores a potential food win; in the dead of night, Jarrell's fire blazes out of control; a survivalist must be medically evacuated.
